topic: The battle where 300 soldiers defeated an army of one million
hook: 300 soldiers held off an army of one million.
script: 300 soldiers held off an army of one million. At the Battle of Thermopylae in 480 BC, 300 Spartan warriors blocked a narrow mountain pass against the entire Persian army. For three days they held. Every Spartan died. But their sacrifice gave Greece time to regroup. Persia never conquered Greece. Three hundred men changed Western civilization. Follow for history's most heroic last stands.
